audit.whatIsWrong: Early rows gave Warwick levels 1-2 on the grounds that Nautilus has 'feeble early damage'.
audit.why: Staggering Blow roots on his first attack against a target and Dredge Line is a 1150-range hook — a root stops Jaws of the Beast mid-lunge, and Blood Hunt does nothing until you are already the one below 50% health. The mirror audit set the shared chart to Nautilus / Nautilus / Skill / Warwick / Warwick.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-4 aligned to the mirror as matched pairs, row 6 flipped to Nautilus to match its own why-text; ratings adjusted.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 spike credited the ult with beating a 'passive shield'.
audit.why: The shield is Titan's Wrath (W), a flat 12s cooldown; the passive is Staggering Blow, a root. Titan's Wrath absorbs damage and does nothing to a 1.5s suppression, so the real spike is opening after he spends the shield.
audit.corrected: Spike keyed to the 12s shield cycle and Depth Charge's 120s rank-1 cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Text told you to 'cleanse the fear from his ultimate' with Primal Howl, and called Warwick's Q an auto reset.
audit.why: Depth Charge is a knockup and stun, not a fear; Primal Howl fears enemies and grants 2.5s of damage reduction — it removes nothing from you. Jaws of the Beast is a 365-range lunge, not an auto reset.
audit.corrected: Removed both fabrications; replaced with the real interactions — root and knockup deny the Jaws lunge and the Infinite Duress leap, and Primal Howl is held for his engage.

edits.before: Your passive sustain wins extended level-1 auto wars. Identify how Nautilus contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Staggering Blow roots you on his first attack, and a root kills the Jaws lunge mid-flight. Level 1 is his — farm it and give nothing.

edits.before: W attack speed turns on against low-HP targets. Only take the trade when Nautilus's Dredge Line is down.
edits.after: Dredge Line (14s at rank 1) hooks you into his root chain, and Blood Hunt does nothing yet — concede level 2.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Nautilus must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Full kit online, but Titan's Wrath is a flat 12s shield that eats your burst — trade only after he has spent it on the wave.

edits.before: Infinite Duress is a point-and-click fight starter that locks his carry tool. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Nautilus's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Infinite Duress suppresses for 1.5s and Titan's Wrath blocks damage, not the lock. Depth Charge is 120s at rank 1 — fight the second he throws it.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Nautilus carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on, his health outgrows your damage and the CC chain does the rest. Nautilus carry threat 7/10 — close it out early.

edits.before: Level 1 is yours because Nautilus has feeble early damage and you control the wave freely.
edits.after: Level 1 is his: Staggering Blow roots on his first hit and chains into free autos.

edits.before: Level 2 is even as both of you build toward a first spike and neither can commit a full combo.
edits.after: Level 2 is his as well: Dredge Line hooks you into a root chain before Blood Hunt exists.

edits.before: Level 3 favours you: Q reset plus Blood Hunt speed out-trades his single Dredge Line poke.
edits.after: Level 3 is even: Jaws answers Dredge Line, but his 12s Titan's Wrath eats the burst.

edits.before: Level 6 is yours because Infinite Duress suppresses through his shield and bursts him before his CC lands.
edits.after: Level 6 is yours: Infinite Duress suppresses 1.5s and Titan's Wrath blocks damage, not the lock.

edits.before: Your Q heal and Blood Hunt speed shred Nautilus in extended trades before he can chain his Dredge Line and Riptide slow into a kill.
edits.after: Jaws of the Beast heals for damage dealt in extended trades, so bait Dredge Line (14-10s) and fight before Riptide's three slowing waves stack on you.

edits.before: Infinite Duress locks him down through his passive shield and lets you burst; save Primal Howl to cleanse the fear from his ultimate.
edits.after: Infinite Duress locks him for 1.5s and Titan's Wrath (12s) only absorbs damage, never the suppression; open the instant that shield drops.

edits.before: Cleanse his Depth Charge fear with Primal Howl before committing
edits.after: Hold Primal Howl for his Depth Charge knockup, not for chip

edits.before: Levels 1-2 favour you — Nautilus is a slow tank with weak early damage, so you farm freely and mark him with Blood Hunt whenever he drops low.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 favour him — Staggering Blow roots on his first hit and Dredge Line drags you into it, so farm safe and wait for your level-3 spike.

edits.before: Levels 3 through 6 are firmly yours: your Q reset and W speed win every trade, and Infinite Duress at 6 pins him through his shield before his CC chain can peel; punish every step-up.
edits.after: Levels 3 to 6 turn your way: Jaws' max-health bite beats a tank, and at 6 Infinite Duress pins him 1.5s through Titan's Wrath; punish every step-up once Dredge Line is spent.

edits.before: Q-bite Nautilus as he steps up (hold Q to follow his dash), weave autos, and let the passive out-heal his return damage.
edits.after: Q-bite Nautilus after Titan's Wrath drops, weave autos, and let Eternal Hunger out-heal his return damage.
